course.description: Rolling Scopes School is a free, volunteer-run educational program. Students learn modern web development through hands-on projects, code reviews, and teamwork — the same skills used in professional software teams.

project.title: The Project
project.description: Swagger Editor is a web application that combines an OpenAPI/Swagger editor, an interactive endpoint viewer with a built-in REST client, and per-user request history and analytics. Users can paste or write a specification in JSON or YAML, preview endpoints instantly, send test requests through a server-side proxy, and save schemas when signed in.
project.technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, Zustand, Monaco Editor, next-intl, Tailwind CSS, Vitest, Vercel
